latest.notes: Overnight day handoff fix: when the calendar day rolls over while a song is on air, the player now stops extending the old day immediately — the song playing at midnight becomes the last of the old day, and the new day's real programming (legal ID + imaging) comes up right after it, instead of playing out ~30 min of overnight music fill first. The handoff is bounded to one element and the top of hour recovers within the first hour instead of being 30 minutes late.
